scope: Independently inspected authored static six-view vehicle concept proposal only

observations: All six panels inspected. Four-wheel loader identity, rounded rearward cabin, paired orange lift arms, bucket and hinged upper jaw, rear counterweight/locker and rear lamps stay consistent.
World use shows grounded tires in a ruined cobbled street, a cleared passage and eligible loose brick/metal rubble. There are no occupants or inhabited-building collapse.

defects.finding: The travel upper jaw is partly open despite the authored shut pose. In AT WORK it remains visibly above the rubble with an air gap, depicting loading/scooping rather than gripping the loose rubble as specified.
defects.repair: For the requested gripping state, lower the upper jaw into clear contact with existing rubble, preserving the loader and lower bucket. Explicitly record any chosen illustrative travel-pose adaptation.
